description: H6b (D249): reaction spells the table offers in a window. trigger attack.hit-self = an attack just hit the caster (the hit is held and resolved again with the AC the cast leaves, so the spell's own effect contract decides the bonus); trigger spell.cast-seen = a creature is casting a spell the caster can see (the cast is held; a failed save of the spell's own counter roll stops it). A module spell may put the same object under its spell-mechanic config as "reaction".
